_business: Anantha Textiles Pvt. Ltd. — established, strong profile
_section_1_business_age: From Certificate of Incorporation / GST registration
_section_2_cibil: Pulled from bureau with consent — commercial + promoter
_section_3_itr: One row per filed ITR (last 2-3 FYs). grossTotalIncomeLakhs from the computation, filedOnTime = filed on/before due date
_section_5_provisional_balance_sheet: CA-certified provisional B/S for the ongoing FY
_section_6_gst: registrationStatus + cancellationHistory from GST portal. Filing consistency is computed live from uploaded GSTR-3B; the static pct here is only a fallback
_section_7_ownership: From MOA/AOA, partnership deed, or MCA master data
_section_8_bank_accounts: One row per current account. avgMonthlyBalanceLakhs and bounceCountLast12Months from bank statements
_section_9_social_media: Self-declared handles, then scraped. One row per platform
_section_10_google_rating: Google Places API — rating + review count
_section_11_online_reviews: Aggregated sentiment across Justdial / IndiaMART / Trustpilot etc. positive+neutral+negative should total 100
_section_12_location: address is the verified registered address (city tier is derived from it). footTraffic / proximity / owned-leased come from field investigation

location.address: No. 42, Industrial Layout, Peenya, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560058

_section_13_competition: competitorCountNearby from Google nearby-search; market share estimated. Intensity label is derived from the count, not this field
